title: Tyra Banks Sues Netflix for Defamation Over ‘America’s Next Top Model’ Docuseries
summary: The supermodel and 'Top Model' host claims, in the lawsuit filed in federal court Saturday, her three-and-a-half-hour interview was cut down to just 16 minutes and then "stripped of context and reassembled to support a false and defamatory narrative unrelated to what she actually expressed."
